description: 从站姿自然坐下，保持轻松的屏幕边缘陪伴姿态。
imagePrompt: Create exactly four front-facing transition frames: relaxed standing, carefully lowering while bending knees, settling into a natural seated pose with hands relaxed beside the body, and a stable seated hold with one very small gentle lower-leg swing. Depict an implied invisible screen edge only through the pose; do not draw a chair, ledge, floor or prop. Keep identity, torso visual mass, camera distance and horizontal centroid stable, and keep the complete head, hair, hands, legs and feet visible.
